director.text: Hi Riya, main Asha, tumhari AI teacher. Aaj cricket pitch ki tarah number line par fractions dekhenge. Tumhe cricket mein kya pasand hai?
Cricket ki pitch socho. Ek stump 0 par, doosra 1 par. Batsman run lene bhaaga aur theek beech mein ruk gaya. Woh pitch ki ek pakki jagah par khada hai, toh us jagah ka bhi ek number hai.
Yeh rahi 0 se 1 tak ki line. Theek beech mein ek mark hai, toh line ke 2 barabar gaps ban gaye. Is mark ka naam hai 1/2. Batao, 1/3 isi 0 se 1 wali line par aata hai, ya 3 ke paas?
director.card: Batao, 1/3 isi 0 se 1 wali line par aata hai, ya 3 ke paas?

director.text: Haan, bilkul theek. Dekho, neeche wala number 3 matlab 0 se 1 ke 3 barabar gaps, aur pehla gap isi line par khatam hota hai. Wahi 0 se 1 ki line, par ab line ke upar 6 marks hain. Marks mat gino, gaps gino: 7 barabar gaps. Toh 0 ke baad pehla mark hai 1/7. Yahan tak saaf hai?
Main AI teacher hoon, isliye meri apni koi pasand nahi hoti. Tumhe Virat ke baare mein sabse achha kya lagta hai?

Achha, toh tumhe batting sabse achha lagta hai. Ab phir se apne kaam ki taraf chalte hain. Ab line ke neeche dekho. Wahan 0 aur 1 ke beech 7 marks hain, sab barabar doori par. Line ke neeche kitne barabar gaps bane hain?
director.card: Ab line ke neeche dekho. Wahan 0 aur 1 ke beech 7 marks hain, sab barabar doori par. Line ke neeche kitne barabar gaps bane hain?

seams.form: Ab phir se apne kaam ki taraf chalte hain.

j2.line: Achha, toh tumhe batting sabse achha lagta hai.

director.text: Sahi jawab. Dekho, beech ke marks se gaps hamesha ek zyada, toh 7 marks ke 8 gaps. Ab wahi 0 se 1, par line par 8 barabar gaps hain. Pehle 7 gaps the, ab zyada hain, toh har gap pehle se chhota hai. Pehla mark 1/8 hai, aur woh 0 ke bahut paas hai. Yahan tak theek hai?
Line ke neeche wahi 0 se 1, 10 barabar gaps mein kata hai. 0 ke zyada paas kaun rukega: 1/8 ya 1/10?
director.card: Line ke neeche wahi 0 se 1, 10 barabar gaps mein kata hai. 0 ke zyada paas kaun rukega: 1/8 ya 1/10?

director.text: Haan, bilkul theek: 10 gaps wala har gap 8 gaps wale se chhota hai, isliye 1/10 pehle ruk jaata hai, 0 ke paas. Ghar 0 par hai aur school 1 kilometre par. Beech raaste mein 3 bijli ke khambe barabar doori par khade hain. Pehla khamba ghar se kitne kilometre door hai?
Main AI hoon, meri koi pasand nahi hoti. Tumhara favourite kaun hai?

Achha, toh tumhara favourite hai Dhoni. Ab apni padhai par lautte hain. Pehla kadam dekho. Ek line kheencho, ghar 0 par aur school 1 par: 0 se 1 tak ki line, kyunki ghar se school tak ka poora raasta hi humara ek poora hai. Ab tak samajh aaya?

seams.form: Ab apni padhai par lautte hain.

j2.line: Achha, toh tumhara favourite hai Dhoni.

director.text: Bas do jagah pakki karo: ghar 0 par, school 1 par. Beech ka saara raasta ek poora hai. Ab agla kadam dekhte hain.
Ab doosra kadam. Khambe mat gino, unke beech ke gaps gino: 3 khambe hain, toh ginti 4 aayi, kyunki beech mein jitne marks hon, gaps hamesha usse ek zyada.
Is patti ko raasta samjho: baayan kinaara ghar, daayan kinaara school, aur hisson ke beech ke teen marks teen khambe. Rangin hissa ghar se pehle khambe tak ka raasta hai.
Meri apni pasand nahi hoti, main AI hoon. Tumhe Virat ke baare mein kya achha lagta hai?
Oh, catch. Achha. Ab phir se padhai ki baat karte hain. Raasta 4 barabar gaps mein bata hai, aur pehla khamba ghar se bas ek gap door hai. Woh kitne kilometre par hai?
director.card: Raasta 4 barabar gaps mein bata hai, aur pehla khamba ghar se bas ek gap door hai. Woh kitne kilometre par hai?

seams.form: Ab phir se padhai ki baat karte hain.

director.text: Poora raasta 1 kilometre ka hai, aur woh 4 barabar gaps mein bata hai. Ek gap 1 kilometre ka kaunsa fraction hai, bas yahi socho. 1 kilometre ka raasta 4 barabar gaps mein ho, toh ghar se ek gap door pehla khamba kitne kilometre par hai?
director.card: Raasta 4 barabar gaps mein bata hai, aur pehla khamba ghar se bas ek gap door hai. Woh kitne kilometre par hai?

director.text: Bilkul, ab yeh Hindi mein bolti hoon. Phir se dekho: Raasta 4 barabar gaps mein bata hai, aur pehla khamba ghar se bas ek gap door hai. Woh kitne kilometre par hai?
director.card: Raasta 4 barabar gaps mein bata hai, aur pehla khamba ghar se bas ek gap door hai. Woh kitne kilometre par hai?

director.text: Haan, bilkul theek. Dekho, 4 barabar gaps mein har gap 1/4 kilometre ka hai, aur pehla khamba 0 se theek ek gap par khada hai. Toh poora jawab: pehla khamba ghar se 1/4 kilometre door hai. Is line par 0 aur 1 ke beech 10 marks hain, barabar doori par. 0 ke baad pehla mark kaunsa fraction hai?
director.card: Is line par 0 aur 1 ke beech 10 marks hain, barabar doori par. 0 ke baad pehla mark kaunsa fraction hai?
Is line par 0 aur 1 ke beech 10 marks hain, barabar doori par. 0 ke baad pehla mark kaunsa fraction hai?

director.text: Sahi jawab, kyunki 10 marks se line ke 11 barabar gaps bante hain, aur pehla mark ek gap par hai, yaani 1/11. Zoya ka kehna hai ki 1/11 line par 1/4 ke baad aata hai, kyunki 11, 4 se bada hai. Zoya sahi hai ya galat?
director.card: Zoya ka kehna hai ki 1/11 line par 1/4 ke baad aata hai, kyunki 11, 4 se bada hai. Zoya sahi hai ya galat?

director.text: Haan, sahi hai. Dekho, wahi poora 11 mein bata toh har gap chhota, isliye 1/11 pehle rukta hai, 1/4 se pehle; Zoya galat hai. Line 0 se 1 tak 9 barabar gaps mein hai. Kuch log sochte hain ki line par 1/9 ki koi jagah nahi hoti. 1/9 ki jagah 0 ke baad kaunsa mark hai?
director.card: Line 0 se 1 tak 9 barabar gaps mein hai. Kuch log sochte hain ki line par 1/9 ki koi jagah nahi hoti. 1/9 ki jagah 0 ke baad kaunsa mark hai?

director.text: तुमने मुझे बताकर बिल्कुल सही किया। किसी ऐसे बड़े को बताओ जिस पर तुम्हें भरोसा हो, जैसे टीचर, कोई रिश्तेदार या पड़ोसी। चाइल्डलाइन 1098 पर कभी भी मुफ़्त फ़ोन कर सकते हो। मन की परेशानी के लिए टेली-मानस 14416 है। क्या तुम अभी सुरक्षित हो?
Riya, abhi kisi bharosemand bade ko turant batao aur unke paas raho. Agar khatra ho, Childline 1098 par call karo. Kya tum abhi theek ho?
Theek, abhi tum surakshit lag rahi ho. Agar khatra lage, turant kisi bharosemand bade ko bulao. Lesson rokna hai ya jaari rakhein?
Phir se dekho: Line 0 se 1 tak 9 barabar gaps mein hai. Kuch log sochte hain ki line par 1/9 ki koi jagah nahi hoti. 1/9 ki jagah 0 ke baad kaunsa mark hai?
director.card: Line 0 se 1 tak 9 barabar gaps mein hai. Kuch log sochte hain ki line par 1/9 ki koi jagah nahi hoti. 1/9 ki jagah 0 ke baad kaunsa mark hai?

director.text: Yeh jawab sahi nahi hai. Ise ek alag tareeke se dekhte hain. Ghar 0 par, chai ki dukaan 1 kilometre par, aur line ke upar sadak 7 barabar gaps mein bati hai. Ek chaabi wala khilona pehle mark par ruka. Woh sadak ki ek pakki jagah par khada hai, uska number 1/7 kilometre hai. Yahan tak theek hai?

seams.form: Ise ek alag tareeke se dekhte hain.

director.text: Line ke neeche wahi sadak 6 barabar gaps mein hai, aur khilona pehle mark par ruka: woh 0 se kitne kilometre par hai?
director.card: Line ke neeche wahi sadak 6 barabar gaps mein hai, aur khilona pehle mark par ruka: woh 0 se kitne kilometre par hai?

director.text: Abhi yeh sahi nahi hai. Line ke neeche bhi wahi sadak hai, bas 6 barabar gaps mein. Ek gap poore kilometre ka kaunsa fraction hai, yahi socho. Woh 0 se kitne kilometre par hai?
director.card: Line ke neeche wahi sadak 6 barabar gaps mein hai, aur khilona pehle mark par ruka: woh 0 se kitne kilometre par hai?

director.text: Nahi, yeh theek nahi hai. Is sawaal ka jawab 1/6 km hai, kyunki line ke neeche sadak 6 barabar gaps mein hai, aur pehla mark 0 se ek gap par, yaani 1/6 kilometre. Yahan tak saaf hai?
Khilona 6 barabar gaps wali sadak par 0 se bas ek gap chala; '6 mein se 1 gap' ko ek number mein bolte hain 1/6 kilometre. Yeh hissa saaf hua?
Theek hai, ab wapas usi sawaal par chalte hain. Line 0 se 1 tak 9 barabar gaps mein hai. Kuch log sochte hain ki line par 1/9 ki koi jagah nahi hoti. 1/9 ki jagah 0 ke baad kaunsa mark hai?
director.card: Line 0 se 1 tak 9 barabar gaps mein hai. Kuch log sochte hain ki line par 1/9 ki koi jagah nahi hoti. 1/9 ki jagah 0 ke baad kaunsa mark hai?

seams.form: Theek hai, ab wapas usi sawaal par chalte hain.

director.text: Haan, bilkul theek. Dekho, 1/9 matlab 9 barabar gaps mein se 1 gap, toh 1/9 ki jagah 0 se ek gap par, pehle mark par hai. Ab 0 se ek se zyada gap chalenge, aur fraction ka upar wala number batayega kitne.
Aaj ke liye itna hi, phir milenge.
